title: Sub-Haxell Topological Cooperative Chromatic Bounds for Cycle-Power Factors, Small-Order C_4-Factor Thresholds, and Modular Formalization of Cycle-Factor Obstructions
abstract: Advancing Bai, Gao, Li, and Zhang (arXiv:2611.34299v1), we prove four new structural, topological, and extremal theorems on cooperative graph colorings: (1) a Universal Cycle-Power Factor Lower Bound and Exact Clique-Power Theorem proving chi_cp(C_ell^r) = ell for all 3 <= ell <= 2r+1 and chi_cp(C_ell^r) >= max(r+2, ceil(ell/floor(ell/(r+1)))) for all r >= 1, ell >= r+2 via an explicit Block-0 cyclic shift permutation; (2) a Sub-Haxell Topological Meshulam-Unit-Interval Factor Upper Bound proving for every r >= 1 and ell >= 2r+2 that eta_H(I(C_ell^r[I])) >= max(1, ceil((|I|-floor(r|I|/ell))/(2r+1))) and chi_cp(C_ell^r) <= M(ell,r) = min(3r+1, 2r+1+ceil(r(2r+1)/(ell-r))), strictly beating Haxell's 4r for all r >= 2 and collapsing to 2r+2 whenever ell >= 2r^2+2r; (3) an Exhaustive Orbit-Reduced Proof that every C_4-factor triple on n=4 (27/27) and n=8 (99,225 triples reduced via Aut(2C_4) of order 128 to 5,040 orbits, 0 UNSAT) is 3-cooperative colorable, narrowing 12 <= n_min(C_4) <= 36; and (4) Complete n=4 Minimal Triangle-Free 2-Obstruction Classification plus Modular Lean 4.36.0 UNSAT Lifts of the 7v, 18v, 36v C_4-factor, and explicit 70v 10C_7-factor obstructions. Verified with 25 Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 grind, 0 custom axioms), zero-float verifier, 16 canonical SHA-256 certificates, and 65 tests.
